rationale: M49 R3 (review claims 1-3). (1) Every method_invocation calls edge carries metadata.argumentCount (named children of argument_list) so overloads sharing the JD20 bare-leaf target (process(String) vs process(int)) stay distinguishable downstream without a resolution engine. (2) JLS 8.4.1: int... and int[] are the SAME override signature — both cross combinations (VarSub.foo overriding ArrBase.foo, ArrSub.bar overriding VarBase.bar) must resolve exact-in-file; this normalization existed in the spread path but had NO pinning test (worked by accident until now). (3) Multi-catch unions emit declared_type references for EVERY member (java.lang.IllegalArgumentException AND java.lang.IllegalStateException), not just the first.
